submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 30 GeV threshold is the recommended choice. This is the only algorithm that meets the hard latency constraint of ≤4.0 μs on the Level-1 FPGA hardware, which is critical because the front-end buffers cannot hold events longer. While Algorithm-L2 and Algorithm-L3 show higher signal efficiencies (92.543% and 86.408% respectively at their optimal thresholds), they do not meet the latency requirement and are therefore not viable candidates. Algorithm-L1 achieves its maximum signal efficiency of 74.581% at 30 GeV, which represents the best performance achievable within all constraints. The 30 GeV threshold falls well within the required range of 20-60 GeV and maintains compatibility with the 8 kHz allocated trigger rate.
